en.title: What communication partners should ask a web development supplier
en.lead: A short list of questions that quickly separates a generic web supplier from one that can support EU project work.

sections.heading: Process and communication
list: How do they handle change requests during the project lifecycle?
Who is the actual point of contact?
How quickly can they respond when a deliverable goes live?

sections.heading: Architecture and accessibility
list: What is their approach to information architecture, accessibility and long-term maintenance?
Can they describe the content model they would propose for deliverables, news and events?

meta.title: What communication partners should ask a web supplier | TechPi
meta.description: Questions for communication partners choosing a web development supplier for EU project work: change requests, contact, response times, architecture and accessibility.
